fields.description:
The packaged code-review guide (`rebar explain review`, source
`src/rebar/_guides/passing-code-review.md`) is the primary contributor/agent on-ramp for
the Gerrit LLM-Review gate — AGENTS.md points at it directly. Ticket bb9b landed the
contributor-triggerable re-review (comment `recheck-review` on a change; merged as Gerrit
change 1243, live in production), and docs/review-policy.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and the
review-bot runbook were updated with it — but the packaged guide was missed: lines
112–114 still tell the contributor a coverage-gap BLOCK requires "a maintainer
re-triggers; re-pushing the same commit or pinging the maintainer is the move". That is
now wrong (self-service exists) and it is the single most discoverable surface, so the
stale text actively misdirects contributors to ping maintainers.

## What

Update `src/rebar/_guides/passing-code-review.md`'s coverage-gap bullet (§"Reading the
vote", lines ~112–114) to say: a coverage-gap `-1` is an infrastructure veto, not your
diff — once the infra issue clears, comment **`recheck-review`** on the change to
re-trigger the review yourself (the bot refuses only when the standing `-1` is a real
finding); mention that `recheck` (CI) and `recheck-review` (LLM review) mirror each
other, consistent with CONTRIBUTING.md §2c and docs/review-policy.md. Keep the guide's
existing tone and line-wrap discipline. Doc-only change: no code, no tests to add;
validation is `make lint` (format/whitespace) and grepping the rendered guide via
`rebar explain review` in the worktree venv.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] AC1: `src/rebar/_guides/passing-code-review.md` coverage-gap bullet names `recheck-review` as the contributor self-service re-trigger and no longer instructs pinging a maintainer as the primary move.
- [x] AC2: The change is merged via Gerrit with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, carrying the rebar-ticket trailer.
- [x] AC3: `rebar explain review` run from the updated worktree shows the new text (packaged guide ships from source, no build step needed).
